product_job: Open the house. Create trust, an account, and a way back in.
user_question_answered: Can I enter, and is this place mine?
emotional_role: Arrival. Calm, first light, nothing asked too loudly.
spatial_metaphor: The threshold of a coastal house.
architectural_character: Welcome is the atrium: plaster, arch, and coast. Later entry screens each have a quieter room of their own.
lighting_character: High side light on the welcome wall. Child rooms stay softer.
material_emphasis: Plaster, stone, bone, a little burgundy cloth.
environmental_focal_point: The arch and the bust on the welcome plate. Not repeated as the hero of later families.
object_language: Bust, books, dark bowl, and cushions belong to this threshold only.
botanical_role: Olive at the edge. It frames the opening. It is not a centerpiece.
negative_space_strategy: A broad plaster field for the live column.
information_density: Sparse. One decision at a time.
panel_behavior: Few surfaces. Forms sit on the plaster, not in a stack of cards.
data_visualization_character: None. Entry does not chart money.
interaction_character: One primary step, then a quiet alternate.
typographic_character: Large display title, short line under it.
relationship_to_previous_family: First family. It establishes the world.
relationship_to_next_family: Setup may continue this threshold, then must leave it for its own rooms.
distinctness_risks: The welcome arch, curtain, bust, bowl, and books are now occupied. Later families must not repeat that arrangement.
